name: interactive

test_list.description: Split handles preserve exact bytes and apply backpressure.
Failed transport trailers after an exit are never success.
The same cleanup routine used by the real gateway adapter deletes only a matching name and immutable identity, and awaits deletion.
Lookup failures, invalid identity and mismatched receipts fail cleanup without acknowledging success.
Read-size limits preserve bytes and repeated reads never turn failed EOF into clean EOF.
Input drop closes the request channel and cleanup acknowledgement remains separate from process completion.

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: Pinned image, content-bound policy, and explicit quotas.

output_description: Dedicated sandbox process with bounded duplex I/O and confirmed cleanup.
